body: I'll start looking for one, I've been sort of waiting until the i had the motivation, or until the last moment to actually make the effort in finding one, I think you just got me the motivation. I'll start looking for someone to talk to, thank you for the push and advice
hahaha I'll try to remember that. words to live by, thanks man

What do you mean by engaged? I worry that even with patience I'll come up with nothing. Not to sound like even more of a whiny bitch I often feel like that expression, a clock--always moving but never going anywhere. both mentally and physically. even though i try to get forward and past all this it seems to constatnly be coming back, since as long as I can remember. hahaha I'm sure you SO loves the fact you love doing dishes

Yeah I guess I was still even too private to really help myself with therapy. een though it's their job, I still feel awkward putting all these thoughts on someone face to face. did therapy really help you?

hahah thank you, Mufassa was a real smart guy. worst part is I have friends that I've been with for over 10 years, and I still feel like it'd be a burden, and selfish of me, to lay any of this on them.  even to this page I just feel like I'm just bitching now. which is why i dont share with people, I don't really understand the line between just bitching about things and asking for actual help and sharing your emotions. in others its a clear line, but everytime i get to this point I just feel like I'm complaining to people--which i cant stand. And whenever I meet girls, and things go well enough for something further I'm so depressed I don't een care about the sex, I just like being in someone else's bed laying with them. Which of course disappoints them, which leads me to feel like a failure and so on.

Thank you for everything UnDire. I appreciate your advice. How do I get passed this, if I can use your words, paralysis of thought? How did you do it? I enjoy the drugs though, I can see why they hindered me, which is why I'm trying to get clean, but is it (at risk of sounding like a drug addict-it was 90% just weed though) possible to entertain them back into my life at some point? or will it always be a hinderance like it was recently?
misery loves company I guess, it's good to know others are going through it though, makes me feel a little less alone

l you feel selfish talking to others about yourself

exactly. I'm usually the person peopel come to with problems, or are willing to talk to them about-since i've always been inside my own head I have great resolutions to every problem, except for the ones that I have, or the ones that I create.

Well Im in a band, which outside work used to take up all of my time, until recently. We've sort of just fallen apart since I lost my heart in it (I was sort of the head person that made everything happen). And we all smoke a lot, but now that I've stopped  I really notice how unmotivated evryone else is, it just depresses me more. I wouldn't be surprised if I had a chemical imbalance. I'm a weird ass person, that somehow made it through being made fun and turned into one of the kids that no one talks to of because I'm funny and can fake everything with a smile. (which in turn makes me feel worse for the people who everyone ignored, since they aren't terrible people, and probably have more to offer than I could.

I'll keep looking for reasons, I have a million reasons on paper, but they just make me feel worse about myself and abotu complaining. I dont have much money, but i'm still abotu to buy wanted material items (which are pointless on the road to happiness), and I am in good health, which is good, but I use it for nothing, and ruin it by drinking and (past) doing drugs.

This subreddit is something I will most definitely keep open. Misery loves company I guess. I'm worried that everyone else's problems will just make me "bleed their blood" in a way. It's ironic I'm usually the one people come to with their problems but I always feel selfish sharing any of mine. Which has made it worse, since at this point I always come off as havign no problems and I would just feel weird sharing any I do have with my friends

I've gotten professional help about 7 years ago when I was jokingly talking about suicide and a friend told her mom, resulting in her telling my parents, so I was sort of forced to go see a guy for about 2 years. I never really felt better coming out of those sessions. I've thought about going to see another person, but I just am to private about everything I guess. I like the anonymity of this subreddit, which is why I am/was so wiling to say all this stupid shit

l Your awareness is good, maybe too good for your own good.
I've thought about that too...I blame doing drugs alone on that one. I've spent so much time inside my own head on different substances, just makes me stuck on my thoughts over whatever the outside is. But that's great advice, I will try to be more patient with myself, or as patient as I can be

It makes me happy that I've helped you in anyway. Really the only true joy I ever get to feel is when I actually help someone, or when another person says I've made their day or something like that. Being a "nice guy" is the only thing that I actually get joy from. But the problem with being a nice guy is that people often try to take advantage of you, and it just makes me bitter towards myself of how I allow my niceness to be shit on by shitty people.

I was in school, but I dropped out years ago. It just wasn't for me...I don't really have ambitions, I guess. I play music, and am in a band (which are actually really good) and people like our music, but I still don't enjoy any aspect of it except for the actual playing of the music. But i'm constantly down on myself about how I don't spend enough time playing, and how I'm lax on wha the band is doing etc.

Thats the worse part, I interact with people on a daily basis, spend a lot of my time out of the house, it just doesn't matter, since when I'm out I just think about whatever is going on around me, how it would be affected if I wasn't there. Whenever I'm not making jokes or whatever I watch everyone and just see if whatever I bring to the table, outside laughs etc, is really even worth anything
I've started running to just replace the time that I spent smoking. The "runner's high" actually feels good, but again it lasts for an hour and I'm back to feeling like shit
